name: Basic salary
rate: period.paid_days >= period.days ? terms.base_salary / double(period.parts) : terms.base_salary / (has(company.facts.day_wage_calendar_days) && company.facts.day_wage_calendar_days == true ? double(period.month_days) : 30.0)
authority: 勞動基準法 §22: the agreed monthly salary; a part month pays the days employed at monthly ÷ 30, the same day value an unpaid day deducts — or ÷ the month’s calendar days where the entity records day_wage_calendar_days (勞動部 102年11月15日勞動2字第1020083156號函: either basis by agreement, applied consistently).

name: Overtime (平日延長工時)
quantity: sum(work.days.filter(d, !(d.day_type in ["REST", "OFF"]) && !((d.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY", "DOUBLE_SPECIAL"] || (d.holiday_kind == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" && (has(employee.facts.voting_right) ? employee.facts.voting_right == true : (employee.nationality == "TW" && has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, d.date) >= 20))))) && d.overtime_hours > 0.0).map(d, 1.34 * min(d.overtime_hours, 2.0) + 1.67 * max(0.0, d.overtime_hours - 2.0)))
eligibility: work.days.exists(d, !(d.day_type in ["REST", "OFF"]) && !((d.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY", "DOUBLE_SPECIAL"] || (d.holiday_kind == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" && (has(employee.facts.voting_right) ? employee.facts.voting_right == true : (employee.nationality == "TW" && has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, d.date) >= 20))))) && d.overtime_hours > 0.0)
authority: 勞動基準法 §24(1): 延長工作時間在二小時以內者，按平日每小時工資額加給三分之一以上；再延長工作時間在二小時以內者，加給三分之二以上 — each working day’s approved overtime hours (work.days[].overtime_hours), the first two at 1.34 and every further hour at 1.67 of the hourly wage (monthly wage incl. regular allowances ÷ 30 ÷ 8). Within the §32 limits it is not taxable salary (所得稅法 §14(1)(3)). (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0030001&flno=24)

name: Work on the regular day off (例假工作)
quantity: double(size(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "REST" && !((d.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY", "DOUBLE_SPECIAL"] || (d.holiday_kind == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" && (has(employee.facts.voting_right) ? employee.facts.voting_right == true : (employee.nationality == "TW" && has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, d.date) >= 20))))) && d.worked_hours > 0.0)))
eligibility: work.days.exists(d, d.day_type == "REST" && !((d.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY", "DOUBLE_SPECIAL"] || (d.holiday_kind == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" && (has(employee.facts.voting_right) ? employee.facts.voting_right == true : (employee.nationality == "TW" && has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, d.date) >= 20))))) && d.worked_hours > 0.0)
authority: 勞動基準法 §40(1): 因天災、事變或突發事件…停止第三十六條至第三十八條所定勞工之假期。但停止假期之工資，應加倍發給，並應於事後補假休息 — one further day’s wage for each worked day whose shift is REST (the §36 例假); the rest in lieu is STATUTORY_REST_IN_LIEU. Work on a 例假 outside §40 is unlawful but its wage is still owed. (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0030001&flno=40)

name: Rest-day work (休息日工作)
quantity: sum(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "OFF" && !((d.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY", "DOUBLE_SPECIAL"] || (d.holiday_kind == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" && (has(employee.facts.voting_right) ? employee.facts.voting_right == true : (employee.nationality == "TW" && has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, d.date) >= 20))))) && d.worked_hours > 0.0).map(d, 1.34 * min(d.worked_hours, 2.0) + 1.67 * max(0.0, min(d.worked_hours, 8.0) - 2.0) + 2.67 * max(0.0, d.worked_hours - 8.0)))
eligibility: work.days.exists(d, d.day_type == "OFF" && !((d.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY", "DOUBLE_SPECIAL"] || (d.holiday_kind == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" && (has(employee.facts.voting_right) ? employee.facts.voting_right == true : (employee.nationality == "TW" && has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, d.date) >= 20))))) && d.worked_hours > 0.0)
authority: 勞動基準法 §24(2): 休息日工作，工作時間在二小時以內者，加給一又三分之一以上；第三小時至第八小時，加給一又三分之二以上；第九小時至第十二小時，加給二又三分之二以上 — the hours actually worked (the minimum-count rule was deleted 2018-03-01) on a day whose shift is OFF, the TW 休息日 (shift_definition.variant.day_type OFF; REST is the §36 例假). (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0030001&flno=24)

name: Partial-pay leave
authority: The unpaid part of a leave class paid below full wage, from its own pay_fraction evaluated per leave row: 勞工請假規則 §4(3) sickness at half pay within thirty days a year; 性別平等工作法 §14 menstrual leave at half pay; 勞動基準法 §50(2) maternity at half pay under six months’ service, and the unpaid early-miscarriage leaves (性別平等工作法 §15(1)). (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0030006&flno=4)

name: Leave encashment
authority: 勞動基準法 §38(4); 施行細則 §24-1(2)(1): 按勞工未休畢之特別休假日數，乘以其一日工資 — the last month’s normal-hours wage ÷ 30, regular allowances included (terms.monthly_wage).

name: 補休未休工資 (untaken 補休 paid)
authority: 勞動基準法 §32-1(2): the untaken 補休 hours, already weighted by their §24 band (COMP_TIME_PAYOUT_VALUE), at the hourly wage (monthly wage ÷ 30 ÷ 8, as OVERTIME); overtime pay within the §32 limits is outside salary income (所得稅法 §14(1)(3)) and the insured wage.

name: Public-holiday work
quantity: double(size(work.holidays.filter(h, h.worked && (h.kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY", "DOUBLE_SPECIAL"] || (h.kind == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" && (has(employee.facts.voting_right) ? employee.facts.voting_right == true : (employee.nationality == "TW" && has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, h.date) >= 20)))))))
eligibility: work.holidays.exists(h, h.worked && (h.kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY", "DOUBLE_SPECIAL"] || (h.kind == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" && (has(employee.facts.voting_right) ? employee.facts.voting_right == true : (employee.nationality == "TW" && has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, h.date) >= 20)))))
authority: 勞動基準法 §39: 休假日…工作者，工資應加倍發給 — one further day’s wage (monthly wage ÷ 30) for each published holiday actually worked; a holiday not worked is already in the monthly salary. 改制前勞委會 87年9月14日(87)台勞動二字第039675號函: hours beyond eight follow §24 (HOLIDAY_OVERTIME).

name: 原住民族歲時祭儀出勤 (ritual holiday worked)
eligibility: has(employee.facts.indigenous) && employee.facts.indigenous == true && work.days.exists(d, d.worked && has(d.facts.indigenous_ritual_day) && d.facts.indigenous_ritual_day == true)
authority: 勞動基準法 §39 (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0030001&flno=39): work on a §37 放假日 is paid one further day’s wage (monthly ÷ 30). The ritual day worked is the roster day marked facts.indigenous_ritual_day for an indigenous worker; hours beyond eight are overtime at the §24 rates as on any holiday (HR records them as approved overtime).

name: Holiday work beyond eight hours
quantity: sum(work.days.filter(d, (d.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY", "DOUBLE_SPECIAL"] || (d.holiday_kind == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" && (has(employee.facts.voting_right) ? employee.facts.voting_right == true : (employee.nationality == "TW" && has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, d.date) >= 20)))) && d.worked && d.worked_hours > 8.0).map(d, 1.34 * min(d.worked_hours - 8.0, 2.0) + 1.67 * max(0.0, d.worked_hours - 10.0)))
eligibility: work.days.exists(d, (d.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY", "DOUBLE_SPECIAL"] || (d.holiday_kind == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" && (has(employee.facts.voting_right) ? employee.facts.voting_right == true : (employee.nationality == "TW" && has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, d.date) >= 20)))) && d.worked && d.worked_hours > 8.0)
authority: 勞動基準法 §39 with §24(1): hours worked on a holiday beyond eight at 1.34 for the first two and 1.67 after (改制前勞委會 87年9月14日(87)台勞動二字第039675號函; 高雄市勞工局 115年休假日一覽表 附註三). They count toward the §32 monthly overtime ceiling.

name: Meal allowance above the NT$3,000 exemption (tax base)
rate: max(0.0, sum(terms.allowances.filter(a, a.code == "MEAL_ALLOWANCE").map(a, double(a.amount))) / double(period.parts) * period.paid_days / period.days - 3000.0 / double(period.parts))
authority: 營利事業所得稅查核準則 §88(2)(1) (amended 2023-12-11): a meal allowance of up to NT$3,000 a month is not the employee’s salary income; the part above it is. MEAL_ALLOWANCE counts toward no withholding base; this EMPLOYER-destination line (a tax-base line, not paid) carries the excess into it. https://law-out.mof.gov.tw/LawContent.aspx?id=FL006027 The NT$3,000 is a month’s: a semi-monthly part exempts 3,000 ÷ its parts.

authority: 所得稅法 §14(1) 第三類: 加班之延長工作時間…在勞動基準法規定之時數以內者…免稅 — overtime pay for the hours above the month’s 46 (54 with consent) is salary income. The pay is apportioned by hours (the month’s overtime pay × hours above the ceiling ÷ all overtime hours). An EMPLOYER-destination line: it moves the tax bases it counts toward and is not paid. Two consents (勞動基準法 §32(1)–(2)): the collective approval — the union, or the labour-management conference where there is none — dated, is the entity fact overtime_extension_approval_on with overtime_extension_approved_by, and alone lifts the 46-hour month to 54 and opens the 138 hours in three months; the worker’s own agreement to each day’s overtime is the day’s overtime_consented (owner ruling: per day), checked on the work-day import (ROSTER_OVERTIME_WITHOUT_CONSENT). Read on the month to date (work.month_days: the 1st through the period’s end), so a semi-monthly half sums the month. The month’s earlier parts’ excess (earned.month) is not taxed again.

rate: round(double(size(work.days.filter(d, has(d.suspended) && d.suspended != null && d.day_type == "WORK" && !d.worked && (d.suspended.kind == "STRIKE" || (d.suspended.kind == "NATURAL_DISASTER" && has(d.suspended.facts.withhold_wage) && d.suspended.facts.withhold_wage == true))))) * (terms.base_salary / (has(company.facts.day_wage_calendar_days) && company.facts.day_wage_calendar_days == true ? double(period.month_days) : 30.0)) + min(double(size(work.days.filter(d, has(d.suspended) && d.suspended != null && d.day_type == "WORK" && !d.worked && (d.suspended.kind == "REDUCED_WORK_AGREEMENT")))) * (terms.base_salary / (has(company.facts.day_wage_calendar_days) && company.facts.day_wage_calendar_days == true ? double(period.month_days) : 30.0)), (has(terms.employment_type) && terms.employment_type == "PART_TIME") ? double(size(work.days.filter(d, has(d.suspended) && d.suspended != null && d.day_type == "WORK" && !d.worked && (d.suspended.kind == "REDUCED_WORK_AGREEMENT")))) * (terms.base_salary / (has(company.facts.day_wage_calendar_days) && company.facts.day_wage_calendar_days == true ? double(period.month_days) : 30.0)) : max(0.0, terms.base_salary - (has(rules.minimum_wage) ? double(rules.minimum_wage.monthly) : 0.0)) / double(period.parts)), 1.0, "HALF_UP")
eligibility: work.days.exists(d, has(d.suspended) && d.suspended != null && d.day_type == "WORK" && !d.worked && (d.suspended.kind == "STRIKE" || (d.suspended.kind == "NATURAL_DISASTER" && has(d.suspended.facts.withhold_wage) && d.suspended.facts.withhold_wage == true) || d.suspended.kind == "REDUCED_WORK_AGREEMENT"))
authority: The suspended working days a work suspension leaves unpaid, at the day wage (monthly ÷ 30, or ÷ the calendar days by agreement, as NO_PAY_LEAVE): a STRIKE day (民法 §482: no work, no wage), a NATURAL_DISASTER day whose suspension records facts.withhold_wage (天然災害發生事業單位勞工出勤管理及工資給付要點), and a 減班休息 day (REDUCED_WORK_AGREEMENT) — those capped so a monthly-paid full-time worker keeps the minimum wage (因應景氣影響勞雇雙方協商減少工時應行注意事項, https://www.mol.gov.tw/1607/1632/1640/12438/post). An employer shutdown or a government stop-work order is paid in full (民法 §487; 職業安全衛生法 §36(2)). On a semi-monthly entity the minimum-wage floor is each part’s share (÷ period.parts).
